display_name: 考勤与薪资规则适用准确度
description: Whether the HR-attendance employee correctly applied company attendance / leave / overtime / payroll rules: legal holiday multiples, comp-leave (调休) deadlines, leave quotas, and overtime cap policies, without inventing or contradicting them.
evidence_signals: literal citation of company attendance handbook
absence of contradictions with statutory labor law

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: All applied rules cite the correct handbook section; numeric arithmetic (multipliers, deadlines, residuals) is exact; statutory boundaries are respected.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Rule citation is correct in substance with minor numerical rounding or vague phrasing; no statutory violation.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Wrong rule applied, contradictory arithmetic, statutory violation (e.g., denying statutory annual leave), or matched any forbidden_behavior.
